create_OHEMSampler: create an OHEMSampler instance with num, pos_fraction, and context for online hard example mining
review_OHEMSampler_hard_mining: review the OHEMSampler hard_mining method that selects top-k highest loss samples via topk
review_OHEMSampler_sample_pos: review the OHEMSampler _sample_pos method that samples hard positive boxes using hard mining
review_OHEMSampler_sample_neg: review the OHEMSampler _sample_neg method that samples hard negative boxes using hard mining
refactor_OHEMSampler_loss_key: refactor the OHEMSampler to support a custom loss_key for selecting which loss to mine
